Review Body:
I got this book for free. Thank God! (I would never pay for this nonsense.)

Here's the situation: the Kindle edition spans approximately 340 pages, with around 150 of those dedicated solely to photographs.
The remainder of the book features Melania promoting herself and Donald as compassionate individuals genuinely focused on uniting the nation. When she wasn't emphasizing that message, she was criticizing the media and elaborating on the various enhancements she implemented in the White House.
I was actually shocked at how bad this book was..
I really don’t care, do you?

Review Date: Reviewed in the United States on October 16, 2024
Review Body:
MELANIA. She is a private mysterious woman who has allowed the reader into her life. She is an independent, empowered and wordly woman who is elegant, graceful, poised and inspiring. She is a successful businesswoman. She has had a couple of businesses and was accepted into a fashion design program and architecture program along with her modeling and jewelry business. She values her family. She may have different views and opinions than her family members yet respects others and their independence. No matter what you think of her husband, she is an individual with her own story to tell. She is authentic.Her story is uplifiting inspiring and educational.
I bought the kindle version as Im traveling at the moment but I plan on buying the hardback version for future reference and inspiration and also share with my grandaughter.

Review Date: Reviewed in the United States on October 12, 2024
Review Body: I thoroughly enjoyed reading about Melania's life and how she views things. She is a strong woman who has separate views from her husband. Since the mainstream media does not like her (or President Trump), she did not/does not get to do interviews for magazines or talk shows so even though she was First Lady I did not know much about her. Very interesting and worth the read. I got the Kindle version.

Review Date: Reviewed in the United States on October 9, 2024
Review Body: I ordered this to read on my kindle today. I liked reading about her as a young child and her interactions with her sister and parents. As she writes about being the First Lady, you can feel the love Melania has for the American people and her pride in representing the USA both here and abroad. She truly has a heart of gold! God bless her and her family.
